name: Trolley Modernization Program
description: Replace the entire Routes 10/11/13/15/34/36 trolley fleet with new low-floor, accessible vehicles. Includes accessible station rebuilds along the West Philadelphia subway-surface lines.

name: King of Prussia Rail Extension
description: 4.5-mile extension of the Norristown High Speed Line to the King of Prussia mall and business park.

name: Wayne Junction Substation Replacement
description: Replace the 1930s-era substation feeding the Regional Rail catenary system. Critical to system reliability on every electrified RR line.

name: Broad Street Line Vehicle Replacement
description: Procurement of 200 new heavy-rail cars to replace the 1980s Kawasaki fleet on the Broad Street Line and Ridge Spur.

name: Route 49 Bus Service
description: New crosstown bus route connecting Strawberry Mansion to Grays Ferry via 33rd/34th Streets. Filling a long-standing gap in north-south service in West Philly.

name: Route 15 Girard Avenue Trolley Restoration
description: Return rail service to Route 15 after years of bus substitution. Includes new ADA-accessible boarding islands along Girard Avenue.

name: Market-Frankford Line 69th Street Terminal Rehab
description: Full rehabilitation of the 69th Street terminal complex including platforms, mezzanines, and the bus loop. Largest MFL station project since the 1990s.
